name: sofagent
description: FDE Harness — on entry, write your business judgment into files (workflows, ontology, AI nodes); after departure, audit every change against them. 28 audit rules (24 git-diff hard evidence), tamper-evident chain, snapshots (104 tools, 11 plugins).
